# 【BOMBANANA!】MONKEY SEE MONKEY DO MONKEY DEAF

## ⚡ Quick Stream Highlights (TL;DR)
- Kobo Kanaeru, Vestia Zeta, and Kaela Kovalskia engaged in a chaotic yet humorous bomb defusal game, 'Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes' style.
- Communication challenges were a central theme, with Kobo Kanaeru realizing Vestia Zeta was mute and later revealing her own black-and-white vision, complicating color-based puzzles.
- They tackled an array of intricate modules including wires, sliders, calculators, Braille-like sequences, and frustrating Morse code puzzles, often resulting in explosions.
- Despite moments of exasperation and self-deprecating humor (calling themselves 'monkeys'), the team demonstrated collaborative spirit and determination, finding enjoyment in the struggle.
- The stream concluded with Kobo Kanaeru, overwhelmed by the game's escalating difficulty and time pressure, deciding to end the session for the time being.
